source.test: inspectTransferPackage(at:) — formatVersion newer than this build supports

expected.error_message: This transfer file was created by a newer version of MSC. Update the app and try again.
expected.rejection_rule: manifest.formatVersion <= ServerTransfer.formatVersion (currently 2) is required (source line 324). Strictly greater is rejected; equal is accepted. A manifest with formatVersion: 1 (an older but still-parseable version, since TransferManifest's fields have not changed since v1->v2 beyond what the app-level bundling comment describes) is NOT rejected by this rule -- 'older' and 'unsupported' are not the same thing here.

notes: The whole-manifest-newer check runs strictly before any per-server processing (manifest.servers is empty in this fixture on purpose, to show the rejection doesn't depend on server content at all) and before port-conflict detection -- inspectTransferPackage returns .failure immediately after the formatVersion check at line 324-327, removing staging first (line 325) exactly like the missing-manifest.json failure path above it (line 314-317) and the decode-failure catch block (line 349-352) do. All three inspect-time failure paths share that same 'remove staging, then return .failure' shape; only the message text differs.
